purpose: Disposable SQLite concurrency verification for FTP-01 Gate 3
source_data: Synthetic FIT activities and synthetic FTP history only

training_state_cold_multiride_get.scenario: Two-ride cold /training-state GET paused after the second calculation, after the first ride had completed. No stress-cache rows had been written. A concurrent FTP history insertion committed before the request resumed.
training_state_cold_multiride_get.result: The complete stale-snapshot cache batch was rolled back; GET retried both rides from a fresh snapshot, returned HTTP 200, and cached the current 250 W FTP results with nonempty signatures.

plan_cold_multiride_get.scenario: Two-ride cold /plan GET paused at the second classification after all ride calculations. Neither stress nor classification cache had been written. A concurrent FTP history insertion committed before the request resumed.
plan_cold_multiride_get.result: The stale cache batch was rolled back; GET retried from a fresh snapshot, returned HTTP 200, and saved two current-FTP stress results and two classification results with nonempty signatures.

home_cold_multiride_get.scenario: Two-ride cold Home GET paused at classification two, after the first classification calculation had completed. Both cache tables were empty and a concurrent FTP history insertion committed while the second classification was paused.
home_cold_multiride_get.result: Home now computes Plan and flushes its deferred stress/classification batches before the Home-only Training State summary. The stale snapshot batch rolled back; GET retried, returned HTTP 200, and committed two stress and two classification rows with current-FTP signatures. Training State summary then read the populated cache.

rollback_journal_baseline.scenario: A long read snapshot held while a second connection attempted a normal FTP write with a 100 ms busy timeout.
rollback_journal_baseline.result: SQLite raised database is locked; deferred reads alone do not allow a rollback-journal writer to commit alongside the long calculation.

verification.focused_concurrency: Training State, Plan, and Home two-ride GET regressions passed; Home write took 0.0034 s during classification #2 and the GET retried coherently
verification.prehistory_integration: A synthetic Nov 8 2024 FIT ride changed from FTP-unavailable to below threshold at 190 W after adding 190 W effective Nov 8; prior Nov 7 remained unknown; prior FTP rows were preserved; stress method/value, daily stress/fitness/fatigue, Plan history, and cache signatures refreshed
verification.browser: npx --offline --yes --package @playwright/cli playwright-cli --session ftp01check run-code --filename tools/verify_ftp_browser.js; 107 assertions passed on the disposable copy with 1,029 candidates (135 above, 744 at/below, 150 FTP-unavailable), 71 FTP rows before the test insertion
verification.source_db_inspection: WAL inventory regression verifies a coherent private copy includes committed WAL content and source database, WAL, and SHM contents/metadata remain unchanged. Unsupported journal/sidecar states are refused.
